items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 26 September 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland and high pressure over Europe and southern England.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, backing south or southwest 5 or 6 this evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate this evening.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast, 5 or 6, increasing 6 or 7 for a time Sunday afternoon. Then veering west by late afternoon, and then gradually decreasing west or southwest 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Area of rain progresses eastwards during the day tomorrow, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor in rain.
